text:
**Date:** The vote took place on 14 March 2024, at the council's regular evening session.

**Named person:** Councillor Odette Varnham, chair of the Pellham Harbour Committee, moved the levy motion.

**Figure:** The levy sets a charge of 2.4% on commercial mooring and cargo-handling fees, projected to raise £1.8 million over five years.

**Source document/event:** The report rests on the certified minutes of the Pellham Borough Council meeting of 14 March 2024, which record the 19 to 6 roll-call vote.
